reading.zh: 按启动顺序读：TestScene（构建第 0 项、挂 Entry）→ LoadingScene（读条，现在还播报地图生成阶段）→ WorldScene（局内世界，GM 面板把生成结果送到这里）；MainScene 与 EnterScene 当前都不在构建清单里。
reading.en: Read in boot order: TestScene (build entry 0, hosts Entry) -> LoadingScene (loading bar, now also narrates runmap generation) -> WorldScene (the in-run world the GM panel generates into). MainScene and EnterScene are currently in no build list.
